events.name: Universal Bangkok Open
events.watch: WNT TV (Bangkok is 12 hours ahead, so play runs overnight ET)

events.name: Ultimate Pool All Ireland: Irish Open
Mosconi Cup press conference (open to fans)
events.format: Thanksgiving Day, 3-4 PM ET (doors 2:30 PM). Team USA and Team Europe face to face the day before play starts.
events.watch: In person; follow World Nineball Tour's social channels

events.name: Mosconi Cup 2026
events.format: 33rd edition. Team USA vs. Team Europe, 5 v 5 nine-ball: singles, doubles and team matches. Each match is a race to 5 for one point; first team to 11 wins.
events.watch: ESPN+ (ESPN App) and WNT TV in the US. Other countries: to be announced

events.name: Mezz Sevilla Open
events.format: 128-player 9-ball, $58,000: double elimination, then single elimination from the last 64. Races to 9, winner breaks. Last World Nineball Tour ranking stop of 2026.
events.watch: WNT TV (Spain is 6 hours ahead, so morning to afternoon ET)
